questions.question:
[지문]
Today is the school festival day. There (A)___ fun shows and activities. Look! The school band is performing. My friend Hojun is playing the drums now. After the show, I (B)____ visit the cooking club. Eunbi is selling her cookies there.

윗글의 빈칸 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 미래 시간을 나타내는 'After the show'와 함께 미래 조동사 'will'이 필요합니다. 'I will visit the cooking club'이 올바른 형태입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Today is the school festival day. There (A)___ fun shows and activities. Look! The school band is performing. My friend Hojun is playing the drums now. After the show, I (B)____ visit the cooking club. Eunbi is selling her cookies there.

윗글의 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'There'는 존재를 나타내는 표현으로, 뒤따르는 복수 명사 'shows and activities'에 맞게 'are'를 사용합니다.

options: To talk about a club and ask people to read
To explain how to make webtoons
To ask for help with writing stories
questions.question:
[지문]
Hi! I'm Brian. This is Dream and Draw, and my club members make webtoons. Mina is writing a story, and I am drawing pictures. I use a painting app for my pictures. With this app, I can use many kinds of brushes and colors. My club members will post our new webtoons on our social media site this Friday. Why don't you visit our social media site and read our webtoons?

다음 글의 목적으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글의 끝에서 '우리 소셜 미디어 사이트를 방문하여 웹툰을 읽지 않을래?'라고 묻고 있으며, 클럽 활동을 소개하고 있습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Do you like robots? I'm Yeji from the robot club, We Makers. My club members learns programming and build robots. Right now, we are test our robots. This is Jake's spider robot. Watching out! His robot is running away!

다음 ~ 에서 어법상 틀린 것의 개수는?
questions.explanation:
1) 'My club members learns' → 'learn' (주어가 복수)
2) 'we are test' → 'we are testing' (현재진행형)
3) 'Watching out' → 'Watch out' (명령문) - 3개의 오류가 있습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Do you like robots? I'm Yeji from the robot club, We Makers. My club members learn programming and build robots. Right now, we are testing our robots. This is Jake's spider robot. Watch out! His robot is running away!

다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글의 내용이 로봇 클럽과 그들의 로봇 활동에 관한 것이므로 'The Robot Club'이 가장 적절합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Today is the school festival day. There are fun shows and activities. Look! The school band is performing. My friend Hojun is playing the drums now. Before the show, I will visit the cooking club. Eunbi is selling her cookies there.

밑줄 친 - 중 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Before the show'는 '공연 전에'라는 뜻인데, 문맥상 '공연 후에'가 맞으므로 'After'가 되어야 합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
① Are you good at singing?
② I'll introduce my school garden to you.
③ Why don't you take a walk with me?
④ This is my favorite place in the school.
⑤ There is a lot of flowers.

다음 중 어법상 잘못된 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 'There is a lot of flowers'는 'There are a lot of flowers'가 되어야 합니다. 'flowers'는 복수형이므로 'are'를 사용해야 합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
① I'll introduce my school garden to you.
② This is my favorite place in the school.
③ There are a lot of flowers.
④ Why don't you take a walk with me?
⑤ How are your club activities go?

다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르시오
questions.explanation: 'How are your club activities go?'는 중복 표현입니다. 'How are your club activities?' 또는 'How do your club activities go?'가 올바른 형태입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Welcome to my club, New Voice. I'm Hayun. My club members sing songs and perform together. My club is practicing for a global music project now. We will make a music video with Melodia, a singing club in Singapore. Melodia and New Voice are not in the same country, but we can create one beautiful sound.

ⓐ The club is not getting ready for a world music project.
ⓑ The club is making a music video with a different group.
ⓒ The name of the other club is New Voice.
ⓓ Both clubs will join a global festival.
ⓔ The club is practicing right now for the project.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것끼리 바르게 짝지은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ. 글에서 'We will make a music video with Melodia'라고 했으므로 다른 그룹과 음악 비디오를 만들고 있습니다(맞음). ⓔ. 'My club is practicing for a global music project now'라고 했으므로 지금 프로젝트를 위해 연습 중입니다(맞음).

questions.question:
[지문]
① My club members makes webtoons.
② Mina is writing a story.
③ I using a painting app for my pictures.
④ With this app, I uses many brushes.
⑤ Our new webtoons will posts on Friday.

다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ② 'Mina is writing a story'는 현재진행형으로 올바릅니다. ①는 'members'가 복수형이므로 'make'여야 하고, ③은 'I am using'이어야 하고, ④는 'I use'여야 하고, ⑤는 'will be posted'여야 합니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
My club members will post our new webtoons ___ our social media site this Friday.

다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 'post ... on'은 '~에 게시하다'라는 의미로 소셜 미디어에 게시할 때 사용하는 올바른 표현입니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
① My friends Jimin and Seojun is in the gym.
② In the picture, Jimin shooting the basketball.
③ They enjoys the game.
④ Seojun reaching for the ball.
⑤ Jimin is shooting the basketball.

다음 중 어법상 올바른 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ⑤ 'Jimin is shooting the basketball'는 현재진행형으로 올바릅니다. ①는 'are'여야 하고, ②는 'is shooting'이어야 하고, ③는 'enjoy'여야 하고, ④는 'is reaching'이어야 합니다.

questions.question:

Why don't you visit our social media site and read our webtoons?

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: ②번이 맞습니다. 글에서 'I use a painting app for my pictures'라고 명시되어 있습니다. ①은 Mina가 이야기를 쓰고 있고 ④는 Brian이 그림을 그리고 있으므로 틀렸고, ③은 미래에 게시될 예정이므로 틀렸고, ⑤는 'Why don't you visit'이라고 초대하고 있으므로 틀렸습니다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I use a painting app for my pictures. With this app, I can use many kinds of brushes and colors.

① He brushes his teeth every morning.
② She bought new brushes for painting.
③ The dog brushes against the wall.
④ He brushes off the dust on his clothes.
⑤ They use brushes to clean the floor.

다음 중 밑줄 친 단어와 같은 뜻으로 사용된 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 지문의 'brushes'는 명사로 '붓'을 의미합니다. ②번 'brushes for painting'도 그림 그리기용 붓으로 같은 의미입니다. 나머지는 모두 'brush'의 동사적 용법입니다.

This is a picture of the sports day. My friends Jimin and Seojun are in the gym. In the picture, Jimin is shooting the basketball. He can jump high. Seojun is reaching for the ball. They are enjoying the game.

다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글은 스포츠 데이에서 두 학생이 농구를 즐기고 있는 장면을 설명하고 있으므로 '스포츠 데이의 재미있는 농구 게임'이 가장 적절합니다.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

options: The car plant makes new cars every day.
There is a tall plant in the corner of the room.
My dad works at a power plant near our house.
We need to plant these trees
We saw many plants at the park.
questions.question:
[지문]
You will enjoy spring flowers there, and you can plant flowers in a pot.

다음 중, 밑줄 친 단어와 같은 뜻으로 사용된 것을 고르시오.
questions.explanation: 지문의 'plant'는 동사로 '심다'는 의미이다. 4번 'We need to plant these trees'에서도 'plant'가 동사로 '심다'는 같은 의미로 사용되었다. 1번, 3번의 plant는 명사로 '공장', 2번과 5번의 plant는 명사로 '식물'이라는 다른 의미이다.

options: The Taean Spring Flower Festival begins on April 12.
The festival includes activities with flowers.
You will have the chance to plant flowers in a pot.
You can only see flowers but not touch them.
People can enjoy beautiful flowers at the festival.
questions.question:
[지문]
My group will introduce the Taean Spring Flower Festival. The festival starts on April 12. You will enjoy spring flowers there, and you can plant flowers in a pot.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'You will enjoy spring flowers there, and you can plant flowers in a pot.'라고 명시되어 있으므로, 사람들이 꽃을 볼 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 화분에 꽃을 심는 활동도 할 수 있다. 따라서 4번 '꽃만 볼 수 있고 만질 수 없다'는 내용은 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는다.
